verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a tax-filing portal, for example batch submissions or handling many receipts or filings at once, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows ELSTER offering bulk actions; the docs describe single guided filings, individual receipt uploads and per-item submissions. The third-party software channel (ERiC) is a developer building block, not ELSTER's own bulk capability, so it earns no credit.
